descriptionHtml:
Bug B01 · P0 · new

Photo census scan never finds anyone: the vision model wraps its JSON in a ```json block and parseModelJson (convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98) silently returns nothing (Hospital and Nursing Home)

Tickets: TFA-94425 ready for qa; TFA-92580 rejected by qa; TFA-92587 AC 3 ready for qa · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: dev + local

Note: Also blocks dev U77; U78–U81 paused for the same reason Review 2026-10-14 (TFA-92587): it also blocks every Nursing Home scan case on dev (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S08, S17, S18; dev units U77–U81 paused). Re-check 2026-10-16 on 25acd727: still there (convex/ai/vision.ts, modelJson.ts and vertex.ts unchanged since e02167f). With a scripted read, everything after the read passes locally (TC-09/S04, S06, S07, S17); the cases stay failed until a real photo is read. Re-check 2026-10-17 on dev 25acd727 (TFA-92580, TC-02): 14 of 14 photo reads empty while the model answered (gemini-3.6-flash, ok, 2.3–9.9 s); in-process on 25acd727 code a ```json-fenced reply gives 0 rows and bare JSON 3.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-03/S18, TC-09/S04, TC-09/S06, TC-09/S07, TC-09/S17, TC-02/S01, TC-02/S02, TC-02/S06, TC-02/S07, TC-02/S08, TC-02/S14, TC-02/S16

Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S08 A resident on today's list who is not on the photo is not dropped from today without a word

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Photographing the nursing supervisor's list adds the residents on it to Today's Visits. Residents already in All Residents go onto today's list, and new ones are created. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 3; TFA-92587 How it works 3)
  • U5 Marking 'In Today' puts the resident on the Today's Visits tab. Un-marking removes them from today without deleting them: they stay in All Residents. (UAT TC-09; TFA-92587 AC 2; TFA-92587 How it works 2; TFA-92587 How it works 6)

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Fixture resident In Today (MRN 'QA-<tag>-10'); QA Alder (Oak 1, MRN 'QA-<tag>-01') in All Residents, not In Today; no date of birth anywhere (D5)

When Scan a one-row photo listing only QA Alder, confirm, then check Today's Visits and All Residents

Then Per the UAT ('the photo adds residents') and AC 3 ('never silently dropping'): QA Alder joins Today's Visits, and the fixture resident is still on Today's Visits. Both stay in All Residents

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: s08-today contains QA Alder and {snfResident} and mustNotContain 'In Today ✓', so a checkpoint saved on All Residents cannot pass (U2 'the photo adds residents to Today's Visits'); s08-all contains both and 'In Today ✓' (U5 never deleted). Judged against the UAT wording. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S08 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from passed to broken.

Issue type: Blocked by a product issue · environment dev · tickets TFA-92587 ready for qa; TFA-94425 ready for qa

On dev, a clear one-row census photo comes back as 'No residents found. Try a clearer photo.', so the test could not check whether a resident who is not on the photo gets silently dropped from Today's Visits.

Evidence: allure 32fce1c4: the agent stopped at the scan error with 4 of 5 checkpoints not reached. Ledger U77: Gemini wraps the JSON in a ```json fence, and vision.scanCensusSheet parses it with a bare JSON.parse (convex/ai/vision.ts:49 -> convex/lib/modelJson.ts:98), so 0 rows come back. Reproduced locally. The same bug pauses U78-U81 (TC-09 S04/S06/S07/S17). Once unblocked, S08 is judged against 'adds' (TC-09 Q1, add vs replace, Daniela).

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: API · API (Convex functions) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · Section: A1 · Home Screen & Dashboard · Scenario: TC-09/S08

A resident on today's list who is not on the photo is not dropped from today without a word

Tickets: TFA-92587 All Residents Attendance Toggle (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status record-only in newspec-c/results.json → passed (record only (every judged cell passed, the rest is recorded only)).

Detail:

Local, rst-tc09-scans.spec.ts: the real Nursing Home scan sheet with ai/vision:scanCensusSheet answered at the Convex socket with the exact rows the case's photo lists (the photo is a neutral fixture image; the read itself — Vertex / B01 — is not exercised); fresh physician per case, names 'QA TC-09-Sxx <word>' as the matrix asks. Open questions recorded, never judged (brief 2026-10-16): Q1 (the scan replaces today's list), Q6 (a row with no MRN is stored with a generated 'SNF-######' MRN), Q8 (a known name with another MRN), Q2 (count wording). T2 / U9 (Vertex Gemini read the photo; model and AI time logged) cannot be checked locally: the read never reaches the server; the 10-15 dev photo10 run logged them (gemini-3.6-flash, providerMs) but every live read returns no rows (B01, still on 25acd727: convex/ai/vision.ts + convex/lib/modelJson.ts parseModelJson unchanged, no fence stripping, Vertex has no JSON mode). S08's core cell is Q1 (open), so it is recorded, not judged: after scanning a one-row photo (QA TC-09-S08 Alder) and 'Add 1 to Today's Visits', the fixture resident who was In Today and not on the photo is no longer on Today's Visits (backend inTodaysSession false), and nothing warned before the write — against the UAT's 'the photo adds residents' / AC 3 'never silently dropping' this would be a Fail; snf.replaceTodaysList replaces today's list by design. The judged side cells pass 7/7 (setup included): Alder joins Today's Visits (exactly once), both stay in All Residents (U5), no Hospital patient. Decision for Daniela: Q1 (same as TC-02 Q6, draft #6(a)).

Evidence: 6 attached.

This case has results elsewhere too (a case shows one result: a verdict beats blocked, a run beats a skip; within a tier the worse one, on a tie the earlier one (dev, dev lanes, local lane A/C, new local lanes), test out of date ranks above passed; when all are skips the dev one, unless dev only says "local only / can't run on dev" or gives the lane's own reason):
